items.title: Unit4 Acquires Napta to Connect Skills Data With Professional Services ERP
items.subject: Napta
items.why: Unit4, a TA Associates portfolio company, is buying Napta: the integration plan is the open question.
items.call: Call the TA Associates deal team covering Unit4: stack consolidation, data migration and product overlap.

items.title: EQT assets rise to €354bn as Coller acquisition boosts fundraising
items.subject: Coller
items.why: EQT has agreed to buy Coller (€354bn): buy-side DD is done and the post-close tech agenda is open.
items.call: Pitch the EQT deal team the 100-day tech plan, an AI-readiness review and, if a carve-out, the separation work.

items.title: G+T-Led Ingenia Gets $2.1B Final Warburg Pincus Bid
items.subject: G+T Ingenia
items.why: Warburg Pincus is in a live process for G+T Ingenia ($2.1B): bids are moving and the diligence window is open.
items.call: Call the Warburg Pincus deal team now: confirmatory tech DD, and a red-flag view on the stack if they are not yet in exclusivity.

items.title: Cleanaway shares fall more than 4% as EQT takeover deadline nears
items.subject: Cleanaway
items.why: EQT is reported to be moving on Cleanaway: a buy-side tech DD is being scoped now.
items.call: Call the EQT deal team today and offer to scope the buy-side tech DD before advisers are set.

items.title: LGT, Coller EQT co-lead EMK’s €1.25bn continuation fund for VDK Groep
items.subject: LGT Coller
items.why: EQT is backing LGT Coller (€1.25bn): confirmatory DD is likely done.
items.call: Offer the EQT team an AI-readiness or scale-up diagnostic as the follow-on.
